invoices.title: Invoices and credit notes
invoices.description: Invoices for your plan purchases and renewals, your credit top-ups and any usage charged to your card when your credits did not cover it, and credit notes for refunds. They are created automatically when a payment succeeds. The spend breakdowns in chat only show where your credits went; they are not invoices.

empty.title: No invoices yet
empty.detail: An invoice appears here after each successful plan payment (purchase or renewal) or credit purchase.

details.title: Billing details
details.description: Printed on your future invoices. Invoices already issued never change.

details.saved: Billing details saved. They appear on your next invoice.
